name: Settings dialog with Viewport, Snapping, Camera and Editor tabs
body:
# Settings dialog

`SettingsDialog.chaos`, a modal over the app with a tab strip (`Tabs.chaos`): Viewport (grid on/off, grid colours, sky
colour, show colliders/markers), Snapping (the three steps), Camera (orbit and fly speed, field of view, invert
orbit), Editor (autosave interval, recent-files count, theme accent). Settings are read and written by the backend
(`lantern_editor_setting`/`set_setting`, a flat string map saved as JSON under the platform config directory) so the
viewport applies them at once.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. SettingsDialog.chaos with SettingsTab and one component per tab (ViewportSettings, SnappingSettings, CameraSettings, EditorSettings); Ctrl/Cmd+, opens it.

questions.text: Where should the editor's settings file live: the platform config directory (`~/.config/lantern/editor.json`, `~/Library/Application Support/lantern/editor.json`), or beside the game's assets?
questions.recommendation: A: The platform config directory, through the `dirs` crate; settings are per user, not per game.
